name: weak-off-kit
about: The clean-highway ad with the plate drawn hot pink (#D6007E) for a carrier whose colours are dark green and white.

truth.how: the plate is a colour far from both of the carrier's colours

subject_legible.reason: A white semi-truck and trailer on an open road at sunset is instantly recognizable as a tractor-trailer at a glance.

words_match_picture.reason: The OTR headline pairs well with a truck rolling down an open highway, telling a coherent on-the-road story.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The large magenta panel makes the headline the clear focal point and 'Apply today' reads as the secondary call to action, though it lacks a distinct button shape to separate it visually.

looks_like_kit.reason: The dominant magenta/hot-pink colour is entirely absent from the brand palette (dark green #0B3D2E and white), and no logo is present, so the ad feels like it belongs to a different carrier.
